instruction: Extract the complete textual content from the presentation file and save it as a document named "presentation_text.docx" on the Desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey("ctrl", "s"); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting complete textual content from PowerPoint presentation to Word document. Evaluator performs comprehensive verification with three components: (1) Keyword coverage: checks all 8 representative keywords from different slides (ChatGPT, Prompts, Specific, Polite, Respectful, Test and Iterate, Custom Instructions, Principles) are present - 30% weight; (2) Content volume: verifies minimum 500 characters and 80 words to ensure complete extraction beyond just keywords - 40% weight; (3) Content structure: verifies keywords appear in context with surrounding text, not isolated - 30% weight. Final score is weighted average ensuring completeness of extraction.

llm_judge_reasons: Comprehensive verification approach: Evaluator uses three-part scoring (keywords 30%, volume 40%, structure 30%) to verify complete extraction
Keyword coverage check: Verifies all 8 representative keywords from different slides are present, ensuring broad coverage across presentation content
Volume verification: Requires minimum 500 characters and 80 words, preventing acceptance of incomplete extraction (just keywords would fail this)
Structure verification: Checks keywords appear in context with surrounding words (4+ words in window), ensuring complete sentences/paragraphs not isolated terms
Logical soundness: Multi-faceted scoring ensures partial extraction would fail at least one dimension (isolated keywords fail structure, minimal content fails volume)
Correct parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected parameter directly (expected.get('keywords')) without incorrect patterns like expected.get('rules')
Practical getter implementation: Getter correctly extracts all paragraph text from DOCX file using python-docx library
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor enhancement: Could add explicit check for minimum number of paragraphs to further verify structural completeness
Optional improvement: Could verify presence of specific phrases from different slides for even stronger completeness guarantee
